html:
/* Template:WorldNext/styles.css (set the content model to Sanitized CSS)
   The small "next boss / next daily event / next game time event" cards for the Main Page hero.
   They always keep a dark look (they sit on top of the hero picture), in the light theme too. */
.wnx-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 100%; max-width: 190px; margin: 0; text-align: left; }
/* hidden until the script has worked out the next event (no scripts = no cards) */
.wnx { display: none; }
.wnx.wnx-js { display: block; }
.wnx-cands { display: none; }
.wnx-view, .wnx-view:visited, .wnx-view:hover {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 8px;
	padding: 6px 8px 6px 7px;
	border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .14);
	border-left: 3px solid #f5cb65;
	border-radius: 6px;
	background: rgba(20, 18, 16, .78);
	color: #ffffff;
	text-decoration: none;
}
.wnx-view:hover { background: rgba(36, 31, 27, .88); }
.wnx-daily .wnx-view { border-left-color: #5fe0c8; }
.wnx-game .wnx-view { border-left-color: #d68bff; }
.wnx-ico { position: relative; display: block; flex: none; width: 30px; height: 32px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 5px; background: #26211d; }
.wnx-pic { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.wnx-pic span, .wnx-pic a { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.wnx-pic img, .wnx .wnx-pic img { display: block; position: static; inset: auto; width: 100%; height: 100%; max-width: none; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; }
/* a random slot of two bosses: the left half and the right half of the box */
.wnx-pic-l, .wnx-pic-r { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 50%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
.wnx-pic-l { left: 0; }
.wnx-pic-r { left: 50%; }
.wnx-pic-l img, .wnx .wnx-pic-l img, .wnx-pic-r img, .wnx .wnx-pic-r img { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 200%; height: 100%; }
.wnx-pic-l img, .wnx .wnx-pic-l img { left: 0; }
.wnx-pic-r img, .wnx .wnx-pic-r img { right: 0; left: auto; }
/* Primal bosses get a coloured outline */
.wnx-ring-pa::after, .wnx-ring-pkr::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 3; border: 1.5px solid; border-radius: 5px; }
.wnx-ring-pa::after { border-color: #b98cf0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px rgba(185, 140, 240, .6); }
.wnx-ring-pkr::after { border-color: #7fd0f5; box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px rgba(127, 208, 245, .6); }
/* three short lines: what it is, which one, when */
.wnx-text { display: flex; flex: 1 1 auto; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; gap: 0; line-height: 1.25; }
.wnx-label { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; color: #f5cb65; white-space: nowrap; }
.wnx-daily .wnx-label { color: #5fe0c8; }
.wnx-game .wnx-label { color: #d68bff; }
.wnx-name { overflow: hidden; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.wnx-when { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }
.wnx-at { color: #c9bfb0; }
.wnx-left { font-weight: 700; color: #f5cb65; }

/* the Gold Trader card: green while it is up */
.wnx-active .wnx-view { border-left-color: #7bd88f; }
.wnx-active .wnx-name { color: #7bd88f; }

/* sound alerts: the bell button and its settings panel */
.wnx-alerts { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; }
.wnx-bell { font: inherit; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; color: #f5cb65; background: rgba(28, 24, 21, .88); border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 6px; width: 30px; height: 26px; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; opacity: .8; }
.wnx-bell:hover { background: rgba(36, 31, 27, .95); opacity: 1; }
.wnx-bell-on { border-color: #7bd88f; opacity: 1; }
.wnx-bell-wait { border-color: #f5cb65; opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(245, 203, 101, .35); }
.wnx-panel { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; max-height: 340px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(28, 24, 21, .97); color: #e8dfd0; font-size: 11px; text-align: left; transform-origin: top right; animation: wnxgrow .16s ease-out; }
.wnx-panel[hidden] { display: none; }
@keyframes wnxgrow { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.7); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
.wnx-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 38px 34px 40px; gap: 4px 2px; align-items: center; }
.wnx-gh { font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8174; text-align: center; }
.wnx-gl { font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.2; padding-left: 6px; }
.wnx-gk { margin-top: 6px; padding: 3px 0 2px; border-top: 1px solid #3a3430; padding-left: 0; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #f5cb65; }
.wnx-gs { text-transform: none; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0; }
.wnx-grid input { display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
.wnx-opts { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
.wnx-optl { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8174; }
.wnx-sound { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 4px; color: #e8dfd0; background: #2b2622; border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 4px; }
.wnx-vol { display: block; width: 100%; margin: 10px 0 8px; padding: 0; background: none; border: 0; height: 16px; }
.wnx-tests { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.wnx-tests button { flex: 1; font: inherit; font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 0; color: #e8dfd0; background: #2b2622; border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
.wnx-tests button:hover { background: #38312b; }
.wnx-showbar { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 10.5px; cursor: pointer; }
.wnx-hint { margin-top: 7px; font-size: 9.5px; line-height: 1.35; color: #8a8174; }
.wnx-ping .wnx-view { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f5cb65, 0 0 14px rgba(245, 203, 101, .55); }
